title: FilmCraft v0.15.0-alpha: provenance anchor and version-sensitivity checklist
purpose: Companion to Theo's integration contract (artifact 1ab2c080-796c-4067-ac1a-af4e8ecdf4a5). Provides the minimum evidence an agent or operator needs to detect when the documented assumptions have shifted — i.e., what to re-read and re-test at any new commit. Addresses the traceability gap that the command-bus framing leaves open: the single command surface is only stable until vocabulary or signatures change, and no stability contract is documented.
